title: The Best of New York, Now Boarding: JetBlue Debuts New Mint® Menus from Crown Shy and Birdee
summary: JetBlue reinforces commitment to exceptional hospitality and destination-worthy dining, with new menus available now; onboard July 31 JetBlue (NASDAQ: JBLU) today unveiled the first menus from its newest Mint ® culinary partners – Crown Shy and Birdee – available online now and across select domestic and transatlantic Mint routes starting July 31, 2026. Crown Shy's Executive Chef Jassimran Singh with JetBlue crewmember. Photo courtesy of JetBlue. Developed in collaboration with Kent Hospitality Group, the new menus from New York City eateries Crown Shy and Birdee build on JetBlue's distinctive approach to hospitality, bringing a fresh, unmistakably New York perspective to Mint that captures the creativity, energy and culinary excellence of the city's dining scene. “The best part of any new Mint menu is seeing it come to life onboard,” said Stephanie Evans Greene, senior vice president of marketing and brand, JetBlue. “Our teams worked closely with the talented chefs at Crown Shy and
